displayName: Warcraft III MDX encoder from UVM
limitations: Accepts UVM bytes and returns one Warcraft III model. It has no dependency on the StarCraft II extension or any other game.

With a BlizzardMDX residual, native declarations are restored alongside common geometry, skin and scene data. Without one, a fresh native model is built from representable common structures; this is a conversion, not recovery of missing native declarations.

Source-free PRE2 preserves static one-pass surface-material priority and Unshaded, and ReplaceableId/SortPrimsFarZ/Unfogged from qualified WC3 particle metadata. Animated, multi-pass and non-surface programs are refused; native integer bounds and metadata types are checked without coercion. Common lineEmitter/modelSpace/xyQuad restore their native bits while head/tail/squirt remain intact. Native flag storage is not proof of runtime sorting, fog or lighting fidelity.

Animated native EmissiveGain retains its independent static MDX header in a finite exact float32 carrier, excluding negative zero; invalid carriers refuse before byte publication. A missing legacy carrier keeps compatibility default1, not an inferred authored value. MDL refuses a non-default static header alongside KMTE until its native grammar is qualified. This does not activate common KMTE playback or qualify adjacent Fresnel headers.

The residual preserves native facts not represented by common structures. Source-free conversion does not promise complete material, effect or bind-pose fidelity; native Editor and visual acceptance remain separate checks.
